text:
elaine: Hey team — getting a customer escalation: hosted API returning a burst of 502s for guest requests when they page large result sets (~500–1000 items). Started ~2026-06-10 12:02 UTC, hit ~4.8% error rate for ~8 minutes. Sample trace ids: trace=trc-0a1b2c3d, trc-0a1b2c3e. No schema changes on client side. Can anyone triage?

lina: on it. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl + body) and the edge trace IDs please? Also which region?

elaine: repro attached in casefile: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Guest keyxxx" \
  -d '{"query":"search","page_size":1000,"page":1}' \
  https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/guest/search
```
Region: us-west-2. One customer only, affects guest (no authz header change).

raj: looking at envoy logs for the window. Seeing many lines like: 
```
[2026-06-10T12:03:12.123Z] envoy upstream reset: upstream connection termination, downstream_stream_reset, response_code: 502
[2026-06-10T12:04:01.456Z] upstream reset reason: connection termination before response complete
```
Also a spike in concurrent streams/connection_reuse drops. Counters: h2_streams_active peaked at 920 (pool configured 1000), conn_reuse_failures +420.

mike: interesting — customer paginates with large page_size so each request opens heavy upstream usage. Could be h2: max_concurrent_streams or keepalive window hitting under high multiplexing with auth-cache thrashing. Any auth-cache logs?

elaine: support logs show repeated auth token validation calls per page request (looks like each page hit triggers a backend auth lookup, not cached). Could be guest auth TTL misconfigured.

raj: that matches. When auth cache TTL is very low and many concurrent page requests arrive, we get auth backend fanout which saturates upstreams causing Envoy to abort some streams -> 502. Repro steps: run loop of 200 concurrent curl requests with page_size=500 against guest endpoint and watch envoy metrics. I ran a quick local repro and saw 502s after ~30s.

lina: mitigation options: 1) increase upstream pool sizing for gateway in us-west-2 (short term) 2) bump guest auth cache TTL and add jitter (fix path) 3) add per-guest rate cap/queue for pagination endpoints to protect upstreams 4) enable prefix/KV caching at runtime for repeated page reads. Which do we want for hotfix?

mike: short term: increase envoy pool and max concurrent streams threshold by 20% and bump idle keepalive so connections are reused more reliably. Also deploy a temporary policy to lower max page_size for guest users to 200. I'll open a deploy PR for the policy.

raj: I'll open an infra ticket to raise upstream pool + tune h2 settings. Also taking tcpdump + pcap on the affected hosts. Can someone attach the exact trace IDs you saw?

elaine: added traces to the ticket: trc-0a1b2c3d, trc-0a1b2c3e, trc-0a1b2c3f. Also customer provided request ids: req-7f8a9b, req-7f8a9c.

ops-bot: SUPPORT-12345 created for the customer escalation (priority P2). Assigned to lina, raj, mike.

lina: immediate action plan: 
- apply guest page_size cap policy (200) via runtime feature flag (canary to 10% traffic) — mike will PR
- infra: bump env pool + h2 concurrent streams in us-west-2 (raj)
- app: change guest auth cache TTL to 60s and add jitter (devex/rollout) — lina
- collect pcap and pprof during the next repro window (raj)

mike: PR: runtime/flags#587 opened, will route 10% to canary within 10m. If the 502 rate drops we can roll to 100% in 30m.

raj: infra change tracked in INFRA-778, deploying to staging then canary to us-west-2. Will attach metrics dashboard showing h2_streams_active and conn_reuse_failures.

elaine: customer notified of mitigation steps and temporary page cap. They're okay with canary. Thanks all.

support-bot: Ticket SUPPORT-12345 updated: status -> investigating. Add logs to the ticket for retention.

lina: follow-up: after canary we observed error rate drop from 4.8% -> 0.4% on canary subset. Proceeding with full rollout of page cap + auth cache TTL bump. Will monitor for 1h post-rollout.

raj: post-mitigation notes: root cause = auth-cache TTL effectively zero for guest pagination path which caused auth backend fanout + h2 stream congestion -> envoy aborted streams -> 502s. Long-term: add circuit breaker on auth backend and enforce per-tenant pagination rate limits.

elaine: closing loop with customer. They'll validate and reopen if anything else pops up. Great job. :thumbsup:
